t: What Vehicle Component Compatibility Database Is All About
title: What Vehicle Component Compatibility Database Is All About
description: Vehicle component compatibility is fitment science: bolt patterns (5×114.3 vs 5×120), offsets, bore diameters for wheels; OBD-II protocols and CAN messages for electronics; bulb types, filter sizes, belt lengths. Wrong parts don't just fail — they endanger. VIN-decoded catalogs match parts to exact trims. Verify fitment before purchase; measure twice, order once. This database is the complete compatibility record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
